title: Local implementer brief: note first, anchor log, one test at a time
lead: *Proposed.* Owner direction 2026-11-15 (relay session 8d711f67, chat: "do (2)", after the orchestrator's review of the local brief): a claude-local implementer gets a brief shaped for a small window. It writes its progress note before it reads anything, logs anchors as it reads, works one test at a time, and has the tool rules at the top. Cloud implementers do not change.
findings_note: S304 trial 3 (2026-11-14/15, S248, runs ork-20261114-224559-2b00 and ork-20261115-001834-20cf): the claude-local implementer ran 8 fresh sessions in 90 min and made no edit. Each session re-read the same 5-6 files and hit the 70k restart before its first edit; the progress note was written once and said only "nothing survived". The brief it gets is the cloud implementer prompt (20,358 chars) with a short local section added.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
*Proposed.* What the trial 3 brief asked for, and why a local model loops on it:

- Work step 1 (`internal/roles/prompts/implementer.md`) loads AGENTS.md, the slice end to end and *the files the slice names*; step 2 re-anchors every cited file:line and edits the spec. S248 cites about 10 anchors in 6 files. With about 26k fixed context and a 70k restart (S358), step 1 fills the session, and each fresh session restarts at step 1.
- The progress note section (`internal/engine/brief.go:97`) says "after each step"; step 1 never ends, so nothing is saved. The restart brief (`internal/engine/round.go:567`) then says "continue its saved work" with "No readable progress note is available" and an empty diff stat.
- The tool rules ("no pipes, one plain command per call") sit in `## Done when` at the very end (`internal/engine/brief.go:200`); the model piped `| head -5` twice.
- One round asks for re-anchoring with spec edits, six tests, a mutation check of every assertion and the full race suite.

The spec check row (cloud) already checks a slice's anchors before the run (S258), so a local implementer can trust them.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/engine/brief.go:95-105` (local sections: note first, anchor log, tool rules at the top)
- `internal/engine/brief.go:195-281` (`## Done when` for a local implementer)
- `internal/engine/round.go:555-567` (restart brief: the note, or a plain "start at step 1" when there is none)
- `internal/roles/prompts/implementer.md` (a local variant of the Work steps, or a local override section; the implementer picks one and says why)
- `internal/roles/roles.go`
- `internal/engine/brief_test.go`
- `internal/engine/round_test.go`
- `docs/design.md`
- `CHANGELOG.md`

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- A claude-local implementer's brief has, before any other section after the role line, a short tool-rules block (allowed forms, one plain command per call, no pipes) and a "write your progress note now" step that comes before any read step.
- Its Work steps do not ask it to re-anchor the spec or run `slicer edit`; they say the anchors were checked by the spec check and to trust the symbol names.
- Its Work steps are one test at a time: write one listed test, see it fail, write the code, see it pass, update the note, next test; the mutation checks and the full suite come once after the last test.
- Its note instructions ask for an anchor log (`file:line symbol: purpose`) appended every few reads, and the restart brief tells the new session to read the note and not the files it lists.
- With no note, the restart brief says "No progress was saved; start at step 1 and write the note first", not "continue its saved work".
- A cloud implementer's brief is byte-identical to today's (golden or equality test).
- The local brief is shorter than the cloud one for the same slice (record both lengths in the slice notes).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Red tests above.
2. Build the local brief variant; keep the cloud brief unchanged.
3. Docs: `docs/design.md`. CHANGELOG.md: one bullet under `## Unreleased`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go vet ./...` exits 0.
- `go test ./...` exits 0.
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check --root /home/jon/code/squalor-xyz/ork` and `adj lint` exit 0.
- `[AFTER LAND]` S304 trial 4 runs a claude-local implementer on S248 with this brief and records sessions, restarts, edits and time in S304's notes.
